scripts.lint: corepack pnpm run lint:web && corepack pnpm run lint:api
scripts.lint:web: eslint apps/web/src apps/web/*.config.ts apps/web/public/*.js packages/ui/src packages/api-client/src scripts/*.mjs eslint.config.mjs prettier.config.mjs
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @stackplore/api-client typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @stackplore/ui typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @stackplore/web typecheck
scripts.test: corepack pnpm run test:api && corepack pnpm run test:client && corepack pnpm run test:web
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run build:api && corepack pnpm run build:web
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm run format:check && corepack pnpm run check:docs && corepack pnpm run check:version && corepack pnpm run check:go-notices && corepack pnpm run check:locales && corepack pnpm run check:contracts && corepack pnpm run lint && corepack pnpm run typecheck && corepack pnpm run test && corepack pnpm run build
